author: OhLookItsDaOne
description: Lets users with an allowed role forward a message to a configured target channel using the message context menu (right click -> Apps -> Forward to Support). Works without the Message Content intent.
install_msg: Cog installed. Configure it with `[p]settarget` and `[p]addunsupportedrole`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only guild configuration (target channel ID and allowed role IDs). No end user data is stored.
